chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The ghusl (ritual bath) of the day of al-Fitr and the day of al-Adha is a sunnah (prophetic tradition); I do not like abandoning it.
ai.seo_question: Is ghusl on 'Id al-Fitr and 'Id al-Adha considered a sunnah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing ghusl (ritual bath) on the days of 'Id al-Fitr and 'Id al-Adha is a sunnah (prophetic tradition). It emphasizes the desirability of maintaining this practice and avoiding its neglect.
